implementation.paired_columns: Original backend debit and credit group references. No sums, netting or zero fill. Duplicate groups fail closed.
implementation.display_precision: Explicit two-decimal presentation using Intl decimal-string formatting, including integers beyond Number safe range. Exact retained decimal remains in tooltip and inspector.
implementation.account_names: Shared ontology SDK query at retained valid/known timestamps. Resource/version and available content hash must match exact report account pin. No current-label fallback.
implementation.source_inspector: Native modal drawer, Close/Escape, unique accessible title, returns focus without scrolling the worksheet.
implementation.scroll: Per-view/company page-position memory on navigation. Worksheet remains mounted and retains its internal scroll/selection.
implementation.nyx: Only composer positioning changed from sticky to normal flow.

browser.entry: Shared retained build history now loads, named SEG report output opens the same Finance invocation.

limitations: Independent NIN-50 acceptance and root production integration remain pending.
No claim of complete Finance/NIN-25/NIN-58 acceptance, statement classification, full-ledger completeness or certification.
Existing historical binding-version mismatch still fails closed.
No new browser fault-injection matrix; labels have explicit loading/unavailable states and duplicates are covered by focused tests.
